definitions.f_measure: mir_eval.beat.f_measure(reference_beats, estimated_beats, f_measure_threshold=0.07): an estimated beat is a hit when within 70 ms of a truth beat, each matched once; F = 2PR/(P+R)
definitions.precision_recall: n_matched/n_est and n_matched/n_truth with the same 70 ms matching (mir_eval.util.match_events)
definitions.CMLc_CMLt_AMLc_AMLt: mir_eval.beat.continuity(reference_beats, estimated_beats, continuity_phase_threshold=0.175, continuity_period_threshold=0.175). A beat is a hit when its distance to the nearest truth beat and its interval to the previous estimated beat are both within 17.5 percent of the truth inter-beat interval. CML: against the truth beats; AML: the highest score over the truth beats, double tempo, half tempo (odd, even) and off-beat variants. t = hits / max(truth beats in the variant, estimated beats); c = longest run of consecutive hits / the same denominator
definitions.trimming: no beats are removed by default (mir_eval.beat.evaluate would drop beats before 5 s; the clips here are short). --min-beat-time 5 reproduces that convention
definitions.downbeats: the same functions applied to downbeat times only
definitions.timing_of_matched: 70 ms matched pairs; over the matched pairs above: estimated time minus truth time, in seconds (median, mean, mean of the absolute value, 95th percentile of the absolute value, largest absolute value); positive = the estimate is late
